items.text: Difficulties in choosing a career usually come from family pressure, limited information, fear of making a mistake, money limits and too many options, and each difficulty has a practical response such as structured conversations, trusted sources, small trials, scholarships and clear decision rules.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
